title: FGC 701: General
officialText:
701.1 Scope.

The installation of gaseous hydrogen systems shall comply with this chapter and Chapters 53 and 58 of the New York City Fire Code. Compressed gases shall also comply with Chapter 50 of the New York City Fire Code for general requirements.

701.2 Permits.

Permits shall be required as set forth in Section 106 and as required by the New York City Fire Code.
